description: This Java source file defines the class 'FormWidgetArtifactInfo' which models artifact information related to form widgets within the Apache OFBiz framework. It encapsulates details about form forms, including their related entities, services, requests, inheritance, and location management. The class provides methods for populating its data from model forms, handling dependencies, and providing access to associated artifacts.

classes.name: FormWidgetArtifactInfo
classes.description: Represents detailed information about a form widget artifact, including its dependencies, inheritance, and location within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: populateAll
methods.description: Populates the artifact info with related entities, services, inheritance info, and requests based on the model form.

methods.name: populateFormExtended
methods.description: Populates the inheritance relationship if this form extends another form.

methods.name: populateEntitiesFromNameSet
methods.description: Adds entity artifacts used in the form based on a set of entity names.

methods.name: populateServicesFromNameSet
methods.description: Adds service artifacts used in the form based on a set of service names.

methods.name: populateLinkedRequests
methods.description: Adds linked requests that are associated with the form.

methods.name: populateTargetedRequests
methods.description: Adds requests targeted by the form.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable display name for the form artifact.

methods.name: getDisplayType
methods.description: Returns the type label of this artifact as 'Form Widget'.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the unique type ID for form widget artifacts.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier string combining form location and name.

methods.name: getLocationURL
methods.description: Resolves and returns the location URL of the form resource.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Defines equality based on form name and location.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on toString representation.
